FIELDS.NAME: Fresh Market Grocers
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 12345 Fresh Market St, Suite 200, Springfield, IL 62704-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Fresh Market Grocers, we operate a retail grocery store with a focus on providing high-quality food products to our community. Our store spans over 3,000 square feet and offers a diverse range of items, including fresh produce, canned goods, frozen foods, and prepared meats, with limited on-site cooking. We adhere to local and federal regulations, ensuring regular employee training and thorough inspections to maintain compliance. Our grocery operations feature effective inventory management practices, fostering strong vendor relationships for consistent product availability. To ensure a safe shopping experience, we keep our premises clean and organized, investing in maintenance of our refrigeration and electrical systems. With a commitment to customer service and safety, we strive to create a welcoming environment for our shoppers.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss dates: 06/15/2023; Cause: Minor water leak due to plumbing issue; Amount: $1,200.00; Status: Resolved. Loss dates: 08/10/2023; Cause: Theft of merchandise from the store; Amount: $2,000.00; Status: In progress, insurance claim filed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Heavy-duty safe, Class B, UL Listed, fire-resistant, and waterproof.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Central station alarm system and security fencing installed around the perimeter of the premises.

FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Fresh Market Grocers has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed during the prior three years. We maintain a strong compliance record and prioritize good standing with our insurance providers.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not lease employees to or from other employers, as we maintain our own staff to ensure consistent service and quality in our operations.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Fresh Market Grocers carries Workers’ Compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect our employees. We prioritize workplace safety and legal compliance in our operations.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not own or operate any other business. We focus solely on our grocery retail operations to ensure dedicated service to our community.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not have any other insurance with this company at this time. We currently maintain only our primary insurance policy for our retail operations.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Fresh Market Grocers is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retailing a diverse range of food products without any significant processing.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not rent or loan equipment to others, focusing exclusively on retailing food products. This practice helps mitigate potential liability risks associated with equipment rental.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Fresh Market Grocers has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years. Our financial records remain stable and compliant.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as we primarily focus on retailing food products with limited on-site cooking. Our operations are designed to prioritize safety and adhere to all relevant regulations.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Fresh Market Grocers does not have any catastrophe exposure, as our operations focus on retailing food products with limited on-site cooking and no significant risks associated with natural disasters or other large-scale events. We prioritize safety and compliance with all regulations.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Fresh Market Grocers has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. We prioritize compliance and ethical practices within our operations.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Fresh Market Grocers has no uncorrected fire code violations and ensures compliance with all relevant fire safety regulations.
